summary: Allow guarded agents to plan and apply filtered repairs with their literal seat identity

replay.detail: No claim replay or repair planning changes.

compatibility.detail: Agent repair apply uses the new /v1/repair/apply-attributed route: older daemons refuse it before mutation. Bound harnesses must supply their own actor there and cannot use legacy /v1/repair/apply; unbound callers cannot use the attributed route or supply actor fields. Legacy token-only unbound clients remain compatible. repair.applied retains its four-field envelope and daemon/runtime author for older peers; authenticated caller JSON is stored in reason before the existing legacy-closures suffix. Subject/class filters and approval tokens are unchanged. Dry-run and status remain actorless GETs with temporary CLI --as compatibility; printed apply guidance stays actorless for humans and uses the effective validated agent identity, including FRACTAL_AGENT aliases, for agents.

downtime.detail: Agent apply requires the updated CLI and daemon. No storage migration or replay is required.

manual.detail: Use st repair dry-run --as "$ST_AGENT" --class revoked-legacy-runtime-start --subject SUBJECT, then st repair apply --as "$ST_AGENT" TOKEN. Existing leading-actor guards support this compatibility spelling without Home Manager activation; after the read-policy rollout, dry-run and status need no --as.

recovery.detail: No persistent state or recovery changes.
